Where I looked

I found 44 carpet cleaning businesses showing up in searches around the Gold Coast, south Brisbane and Ipswich, and chose 3 of them to read closely (what they offer, who they are, their proof and any advertising they run). The other 41 I haven't read closely, so what I say below is about what I've seen so far. I also looked at 45 search terms people use, your own website, and your 8 Google reviews.

The proof for this service

Proof is what helps someone who hasn't met you feel confident. Today you have a 5.0 rating from 8 Google reviews (09/11/2026), and 2 of those mention carpet, so there's a lovely start here and I'd value your help building on it.

A question, please
One customer wrote: "Great results cleaning our carpets even though they are older carpet." I'd recommend this as the first line of proof for this service, with that customer's permission. Does that job sit well with you as an example?
Another review reads "clean my unit in closing steam clean the carpets". Was that a carpet clean on its own, or a clean of the whole unit at a move?
Would you be happy to share a sample of the written report you send, with any personal details removed?
Would you have any before and after photos from real home carpet jobs? I'd recommend these, as your website's photos are mostly outdoor work today.
Would you be comfortable asking your next few home carpet customers for a Google review? I'd recommend it, as that's where someone comparing you will look first.

Anything you'd change or add here?

The offer for this service

This is what someone is invited to do, and what they can expect when they do.

A question, please
Your website offers a free quote and shows no price. People often ask about cost first. Would you like to explain what moves the price, give a guide by room that you firm up from photos and the room count, or offer a firm price after a free look? A guide is quickest for someone ready to book, and a firm price after a look suits premium and answers the worry about the bill creeping up. Which feels right to you?
Your website says: "Isaac reads every enquiry himself and comes back with a free quote, usually the same day." Are you comfortable keeping that promise on home carpet enquiries? I've left the name as it reads on your website for now, so please let me know which name you'd like people to see.
Who usually does the work on a home carpet job: you, or someone from your crew? People want to know who is coming into their home, so I'd recommend saying so plainly.
What can people expect about arrival times? Would you be happy to give a time window, and to let them know if you're running late?
About how long do your carpets usually take to dry? I'd recommend giving a range you're happy to stand behind, as people plan their day around it.
How do you handle furniture, and does it change the price?
Do you treat pet odour on carpet, and would you like that work?
What happens if someone's plans change after they've booked?
What would you like to offer tenants moving out, and would you like more of that work?
Would you like wet or musty carpet jobs, or would you rather leave those?
When you're at a home for carpet, would you like to mention outside washing in the same visit?

Anything you'd change or add here?
